subject: Quasar Labs — demo credit request & co-sell listing certification
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Miguel Santos <miguel@quasarlabs.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Dec 2028 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Quasar Labs — demo credit request & co-sell listing certification

Hi Miguel —

Thanks again for the quick chat last week. Per our roadmap discussion, Quasar Labs looks like a strong candidate for a co-sell listing across AWS and GCP. Two quick asks to keep the listing on the upcoming cadence:

1) Can you complete the attached evidence checklist (basic security and product screenshots) and return it by EOD next Wednesday? That will let our listing team validate integration and entitlements.
2) Quasar mentioned needing $10k in demo credits (AWS/GCP) to run joint workshops with two strategic prospects — we can support that, but we need the demo credit request form filled and an internal approvals timeline from your side.

Attaching our standard evidence checklist and a demo-credit template for your procurement team. If it helps, we can book a 30-min sync to walk through the checklist fields.

Next steps from our side: Ben will propose a co-sell commercial term sheet draft and Olga can confirm technical entitlements (privatelink/VPC, VPC peering, or Private Service Connect).

Thanks —

Sean Gallagher
Sr. Partner Manager, Alliances
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: quasar-evidence-checklist.pdf (application/pdf)]
[Attachment: demo-credit-form.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Miguel Santos <miguel@quasarlabs.io>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: legal@quasarlabs.io, procurement@quasarlabs.io
Date: Mon, 11 Dec 2028 11:48:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Quasar Labs — demo credit request & co-sell listing certification

Hi Sean —

Appreciate the clear asks. A few clarifications from our side:

- Timeline: procurement can return the demo-credit form within 3 business days once we confirm the dollar amount and which cloud(s) those credits should be issued against.
- Security evidence: we can provide SOC-2 summary and network topology screenshots, but a few checklist items ask for telemetry hooks that are currently gated by our infra team. Could Redwood accept placeholder screenshots with a follow-up technical validation call?
- Technical: we plan to support Private Service Connect on GCP and VPC Endpoints on AWS. We need to confirm whether Redwood expects Privatelink-style certs for co-sell entitlement.

Proposing a short working session Wednesday 10–10:30 PT to align on the evidence gaps and demo credit routing. Is Ben (commercial) and Olga (integration) available?

Thanks,
Miguel Santos
Head of Partnerships
Quasar Labs

[No attachments in this reply]

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Miguel Santos <miguel@quasarlabs.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Dec 2028 13:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Quasar Labs — demo credit request & co-sell listing certification

Sounds good — thanks Miguel. Ben and Olga, looping you in to confirm availability for Wed 10–10:30 PT and to flag the two asks: 1) commercial draft for $10k joint demo credit allocation (split by cloud if needed) and 2) technical validation scope for Private Service Connect / VPC endpoints.

Ben: can you draft the term sheet language we typically use for demo credits and co-sell entitlements? Small preference for a 6-month timebox on credits and a simple joint-marketing clause.

Olga: can you outline the minimal technical evidence that Redwood needs to mark Quasar as co-sell-ready? If Private Service Connect counts, that would simplify the integration validation. If not, please note any certs or network proofs we require.

If anyone prefers a 45-min slot instead of 30, say so and I’ll expand the invite.

Best,
Sean

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Miguel Santos <miguel@quasarlabs.io>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Dec 2028 08:35:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Quasar Labs — demo credit request & co-sell listing certification

Quick update from commercial:

- Draft term sheet attached — simple exhibit tying $10k demo credits to two named accounts and valid for 6 months. We included a clause for cloud-specific allocation and an opt-in joint-marketing paragraph.
- We typically route demo credits through our cloud partners (AWS/GCP) or via a Redwood-managed promo voucher if the partner prefers; Miguel, let us know which you prefer.
- For co-sell eligibility we require: completed evidence checklist, a validated joint-demo script, and a signed mutual action plan (MAP).

I attached the term sheet and the MAP template. Once Miguel confirms demo-credit routing, procurement can send the completed demo-credit-form to finance for fulfillment.

Ben Carter
Director, Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-co-sell-term-sheet.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Miguel Santos <miguel@quasarlabs.io>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Dec 2028 11:22:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Quasar Labs — demo credit request & co-sell listing certification

Hi Miguel —

Thanks for the plan. Technical clarifications from my side:

- Private Service Connect (GCP) + VPC Endpoint (AWS) are fine as long as you can provide:
  * Network topology screenshot showing the endpoint and path to Redwood’s ingestion host
  * Confirmation whether traffic is mutual TLS (mTLS) or TLS only
  * Short runbook for onboarding a new customer (1–2 pages) that shows auth flow and required permissions

- If you can’t yet provide telemetry hooks, we can accept a placeholder with a commit date for the infra change. We’ll treat that as a staggered validation: listing pending -> co-sell-ready once telemetry is live.

Also looping in Julia Park from AWS (cc’d) to confirm whether AWS needs a separate Private Offer flow for the demo credits or if Redwood should manage the fulfillment. Julia — can you advise?

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Principal Integration Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Julia Park <julia.park@amazon.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Miguel Santos <miguel@quasarlabs.io>
Date: Wed, 13 Dec 2028 14:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Quasar Labs — demo credit request & co-sell listing certification

Hi all —

Thanks for including AWS. For the demo credits, AWS prefers a Private Offer be issued via the Publisher portal for visibility. Redwood can coordinate the offer but Quasar needs to confirm the AWS account IDs that will receive credits. If you prefer Redwood to issue a Redwood-managed promo voucher (faster), we can process that without a Private Offer but the credits will not show as AWS-originated.

If you want, I can open the Private Offer on your behalf once I have the finalized term sheet and the two target account IDs. Also happy to join the Wed working session if helpful.

Best,
Julia Park
Partner Development Manager, AWS Marketplace
